title: Discrete Space-Time Wave Kernels on Regular Trees
summary: We study the forward discrete space-time wave equation on the homogeneous $(q+1)$-regular tree $T_{q+1}$ associated with a two-parameter generalized Laplacian. Under the natural nonnegativity assumption on this operator, we derive explicit formulas for the two fundamental wave kernels. The formulas are given in terms of discrete $I$-Bessel functions and yield convolution representations for solutions with general initial conditions.
